_readme: The one place a raw colour value outside app/globals.css is legitimised (SC-1, plan 04-01).
Keyed on { file, value } — NEVER on a line number, because line numbers drift.
class is exactly one of: brand-exempt | demo-verbatim | pending-conversion.
brand-exempt       a third party's brand colour that cannot be tokenised.
demo-verbatim      an accent-derived / gradient-stop value that comes from an approved
design/screens/*.html mockup (D-11), not from an invention. Adjudication T-2:
these are allowlisted rather than tokenised, because the UI-SPEC's
'exactly one new token (--scrim)' budget stands. No --shadow-accent token.
pending-conversion a genuine stray with no mockup provenance, to be replaced with an existing
token by the plan named in fixed_by. Plan 04-14 asserts this class is empty
provenance records the measured grep counts: `grep -c -F '<value>' design/screens/*.html design/foundations.html`.
Gate: `node scripts/audit-tokens.ts`. A STALE entry (matching nothing) is a failure too — when a
later plan converts a value, it must delete that value's entry in the same commit.

entries.justification: The OAuth button's hover border (`hover:border-[#CFC7B9]`). Plan 04-01 predicted brand-exempt ('the provider border in the same file'), but measurement contradicts that: this is a warm neutral one step darker than --border-strong (#DDD6CA), it is no third party's brand colour, and it is present verbatim in two mockups that were tracked long before this phase. Classified by evidence per the plan's own rule. Convertible later if a --border-hover token is ever budgeted; until then it is demo-verbatim, not exempt.

entries.justification: Landing hero radial wash, inner stop. Plan 04-01 (following 04-RESEARCH Pitfall 1 class 3) predicted this was a genuine stray to be converted by 04-13; the mandated provenance check contradicts that — it is present verbatim in landing.html and auth-error.html, both tracked since 2026-07-21. Reclassified to demo-verbatim per the plan's explicit 'if provenance turns up, reclassify' rule. If 04-13 converts it anyway, this entry must be deleted in the same commit or the gate reports it stale.

entries.justification: Primary-button shadow in a component that is in NO render tree: its topbar render site and import were retired under EC-09 (plan 03-16, see STATE.md), and the file is retained on disk only as the Phase-1 success-criterion-5 evidence artifact. This raw value therefore cannot reach a user. Kept allowlisted rather than deleted because the file is deliberately preserved, and an un-allowlisted value in a tracked file would fail the gate for a value with no user-visible effect.
